instruction: Read the visit schedule in the source. For every visit scheduled in the reporting period, check two things against the columns: (1) does the physician order expire on or before the visit date, and (2) has the patient had a recorded change in condition since the last note. List every visit that fails a check as one line: visit date, patient code, nurse code, and exactly what is wrong. Then list the visits that are clear. FINALLY: if the source contains a section about patterns with no visit scheduled, list each one and say plainly that the calendar has a hole a human must fill - generating visits is the agency's job, and a silent hole means a patient is quietly dropped. A nurse walking into a visit with a lapsed order or a stale picture of the patient is the failure this check exists to prevent.
description: Every visit in the reporting period appears exactly once, either flagged or clear. No visit date or patient code appears that is not in the schedule.
